subject: Hosted API commit amendment & rate-limit increase request
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@keyboardai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:22:11 -0700
Subject: Renewal + scale request: higher monthly commit & burst rates

Hey Marissa,

Quick note as we prepare for our April launch: our forecasted token consumption has jumped since last quarter. We currently have a 200M token/mo hosted commit but we expect to peak around ~600M token/mo across our search and generation paths for the next 6 months.

Two asks:
- Can we increase the hosted monthly commit to 600M with corresponding unit pricing/discounts?
- We also need a higher burst rate during sync jobs — target 500 rps burst, steady-state 120 rps. Any changes required to the plan or SLOs?

We'd ideally lock terms this month so procurement can issue a PO the week of Mar 22. Also tagging legal (legal@keyboardai.com) — they may need the SOC2 and Docs.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Platform
KeyboardAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@keyboardai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + scale request: higher monthly commit & burst rates

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the product milestone. We can definitely support a 600M/mo commit on Hosted. A few immediate notes:

- Pricing: we can propose a stepped volume discount vs. your current commit. I asked Rishi to draft a quote and a quick P&L showing per-token economics for 200M -> 600M.
- Rate limits: Hosted can be adjusted to support 500 rps bursts; we'll need to configure per-route rate limiting and bump your global soft limit. That policy will be part of the amendment.
- Term: are you thinking 12 or 18 months? Longer term unlocks better unit pricing (and reserved capacity priorities for Dedicated if you'd prefer).

Attached is a usage worksheet — fill in any missing peak windows and expected QPS by endpoint and I’ll have Rishi mark up the quote.

Next steps:
1) Jordan fills worksheet (attached).
2) Rishi returns a formal quote and amendment draft.
3) We circulate to legal and finalize PO/DocuSign.

Would you be free for a 30-min sync Thu 3 PM PT to run numbers?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-usage-worksheet.xlsx (stated attachment)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan@keyboardai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:42:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + scale request: higher monthly commit & burst rates

Marissa / Jordan —

I ran a quick model based on the worksheet Marissa shared. High-level proposal:

- Amendment: increase hosted commit from 200M -> 600M tokens/month.
- Term: 12 months (with option to extend to 18 for an additional 6% discount).
- Unit pricing: tiered buckets (0-200M at current rate, 200M-600M at -18% unit price).
- Rate limits: global burst = 500 rps; steady = 120 rps; per-route caps configurable per your endpoints.
- SLA: same latency SLOs; we’ll add a rate-limit escalation path and a one-time priority burst allowance for launch week.

I attached a candidate quote and redlined amendment for internal comment. If Jordan confirms the term length we’ll push the DocuSign package and route to contracts.

P.S. If we anticipate sustained >800M in Q3, we should discuss Dedicated reserved capacity — cheaper per-token and guaranteed GPU pool.

Thanks,
Rishi
Attachment: redwood-quote-v2.pdf (pricing + amendment)
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@keyboardai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@keyboardai.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 13:15:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + scale request: higher monthly commit & burst rates

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from our side:
1) Term: we prefer 18 months to lock pricing for the next 1.5 years.
2) PO: procurement will issue a PO once the amendment is signed. Can you include an invoice-ready line item for the monthly commit?
3) Compliance: legal needs the SOC2 report and a contact for security for a short questionnaire.

We're ok with the -18% step for the mid-tier; want to confirm the one-time priority burst is documented for launch week (Apr 12–18). We'll upload a PO placeholder (PO_KeyboardAI_0326.pdf) when you send the final DocuSign.

Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@keyboardai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + scale request: higher monthly commit & burst rates

Jordan —

Great — thanks for confirming the 18-month term. Summary and next steps below (so procurement/legal have one doc to reference):

Summary of amendment (attached):
- Hosted monthly commit: increase to 600M tokens/mo
- Term: 18 months (Mar 22, 2026 - Sep 21, 2027)
- Pricing: stepped discount; 200M->600M at -18% unit price vs current rate
- Rate limits: global burst 500 rps during launch window (Apr 12–18), steady 120 rps thereafter; per-route caps configurable
- SLA/ops: retention of current latency SLOs; add priority-burst escalation channel and 2-hour incident response during launch week

Attachments sent: redwood-quote-v2.pdf (final quote & amendment), SOC2-report.pdf (redwood SOC2 Type II excerpt), redwood-usage-worksheet.xlsx (filled by KeyboardAI).

Action items:
1) Jordan/legal: review attachments, confirm text for invoice line and PO details.
2) KeyboardAI procurement: share PO once DocuSign completes — I will create DocuSign package today and set signing order to include legal + procurement.
3) Redwood: provision rate-limit increases and schedule a pre-launch ops call Apr 8 to rehearse burst scenarios (Priyom to schedule).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/prepare/ABCD-KeyboardAI-Amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/keyboardai/KD-1893

If that all looks good I’ll send the DocuSign and the final invoice line item.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
